STOP.


Do not add a console fallback.


The Lyra 0.0.1 application is GUI-only according to the documented requirements. If the GUI dependency is unavailable, fail clearly with a dependency error. Do not implement a second console onboarding path.


Also do not call this a "minimal but complete GUI implementation". The application must implement the actual documented Lyra architecture.


Before creating more GUI code, ensure the architecture is real:


GUI
→ onboarding/application state
→ identity and personality state
→ Lyra brain/coordinator
→ model capability
→ local Ollama model


The brain is not the model.


Do not create a GUI that directly calls Ollama or hardcodes AI responses.


Do not create fallback/mock/prototype behavior.


Use a proper Python package structure and correct imports.


Continue implementing the actual Lyra 0.0.1 application and validate it by running the GUI.
